import polars as pl from great_tables import GT, html, loc, md, style cng_atc = pl.read_csv("../data/contest/latam/commonnamegroup_atc.csv") atc = pl.read_csv("../data/contest/latam/atcclass.csv") # join the two tables; the first letter of the ATC code is the main group merged = ( cng_atc.join(atc.select("atcclassid", "code", "name"), on="atcclassid", how="left") .filter(pl.col("code").is_not_null()) .with_columns(pl.col("code").str.slice(0, 1).alias("first_level")) ) total_preparations = merged["commonnamegroupid"].n_unique() atc_first_level_names = { "A": "Alimentary tract and metabolism", "B": "Blood and blood forming organs", "C": "Cardiovascular system", "D": "Dermatologicals", "G": "Genito-urinary system and sex hormones", "H": "Systemic hormonal preparations (excluding sex hormones and insulins)", "J": "Antiinfectives for systemic use", "L": "Antineoplastic and immunomodulating agents", "M": "Musculo-skeletal system", "N": "Nervous system", "P": "Antiparasitic products, insecticides and repellents", "R": "Respiratory system", "S": "Sensory organs", "V": "Various", } category_summary = ( merged.group_by("first_level") .agg( pl.col("commonnamegroupid").n_unique().alias("n_drugs"), pl.col("atcclassid").n_unique().alias("n_atc_classes"), ) .with_columns( pl.col("first_level").replace_strict(atc_first_level_names).alias("category_name"), (pl.col("n_drugs") / total_preparations * 100).alias("percentage"), (pl.col("n_drugs") / pl.col("n_atc_classes")).alias("avg_preps_per_class"), ) .sort("n_drugs", descending=True) ) main_table = ( GT(category_summary.select( pl.col("first_level").alias("ATC Code"), pl.col("category_name").alias("Category"), pl.col("n_drugs").alias("Unique Preparations"), pl.col("n_atc_classes").alias("ATC Classes"), pl.col("percentage").alias("Share (%)"), pl.col("avg_preps_per_class").alias("Avg Preps/Class"), )) .tab_header( title=md("**Latin American Drug Preparations by ATC Category**"), subtitle=f"Analysis of {total_preparations:,} unique preparations across 14 therapeutic areas", ) .cols_align(align="center", columns="ATC Code") .cols_align(align="left", columns="Category") .cols_align(align="right", columns=["Unique Preparations", "ATC Classes", "Share (%)", "Avg Preps/Class"]) .fmt_number(columns=["Unique Preparations", "ATC Classes"], decimals=0) .fmt_number(columns=["Share (%)", "Avg Preps/Class"], decimals=1) .data_color( columns="Share (%)", palette=["black", "#2d7bb6"], domain=[0, category_summary["percentage"].max()], ) # Great Tables' fill has no alpha: the colour is given with one .tab_style(style=style.fill(color="rgb(187 175 218 / 0.1)"), locations=loc.body(rows=[0, 1, 2])) .tab_spanner(label="Volume Metrics", columns=["Unique Preparations", "ATC Classes"]) .tab_spanner(label="Distribution Metrics", columns=["Share (%)", "Avg Preps/Class"]) .cols_label({"Avg Preps/Class": html("Avg Preps
per Class")}) .tab_source_note(md("**Data:** sydmizar/drugs-datasets (latam_csv) | **Classification:** WHO ATC System")) # Great Tables 1.1 has no footnotes yet: they are written as source notes .tab_source_note("Category: Categories ranked by total unique preparations") .tab_source_note("Avg Preps per Class: Average number of unique preparations per ATC class within category") .tab_options( table_font_size="14px", heading_title_font_size="20px", heading_subtitle_font_size="14px", heading_align="left", column_labels_font_weight="bold", row_group_font_weight="bold", data_row_padding="6px", source_notes_font_size="11px", ) ) main_table

top_5_codes = category_summary.head(5)["first_level"].to_list()

top_detail = (
    merged.filter(pl.col("first_level").is_in(top_5_codes))
    .group_by("first_level", "atcclassid", "name")
    .agg(pl.col("commonnamegroupid").n_unique().alias("n_preps"))
    .join(category_summary.select("first_level", "category_name", "n_drugs"), on="first_level", how="left")
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("n_preps") / pl.col("n_drugs") * 100).alias("pct_of_category"),
        pl.concat_str("first_level", pl.lit(" - "), "category_name").alias("category_label"),
    )
    # the eight largest classes of each category, ties by the order of the classes
    .sort(["category_label", "n_preps", "atcclassid"], descending=[False, True, False])
    .group_by("category_label", maintain_order=True)
    .head(8)
    .select(
        pl.col("category_label").alias("Category"),
        pl.col("name").alias("ATC Class Name"),
        pl.col("n_preps").alias("Preparations"),
        pl.col("pct_of_category").alias("% of Category"),
    )
)

(
    GT(top_detail, groupname_col="Category")
    .tab_header(
        title=md("**Most Common ATC Classes Within Top 5 Categories**"),
        subtitle="Showing up to 8 most prevalent classes per category",
    )
    .fmt_number(columns="Preparations", decimals=0)
    .fmt_number(columns="% of Category", decimals=1)
    .data_color(columns="Preparations", palette=["#f7f7f7", "#d73027"])
    .cols_align(align="left", columns="ATC Class Name")
    .cols_align(align="right", columns=["Preparations", "% of Category"])
    .tab_options(
        table_font_size="13px",
        row_group_font_weight="bold",
        row_group_background_color="#f0f0f0",
        data_row_padding="5px",
    )
    .tab_source_note("Classes ordered by number of unique preparations within each category")
)

max_drugs = category_summary["n_drugs"].max() def count_bar(x): # the count in white on a bar as long as its share of the largest count bar_pct = x / max_drugs * 100 return ( "
